note: Sections that refer a bail-drafting request to a lawyer with no draft (trafficking, sexual offences, offences against a child). A lawyer confirms, strikes or adds entries. Section numbers are checked against the held India Code texts (BNS) and the held IPC asset; a request names its sections itself, the engine infers none. `refer_by_name`: an Act whose mere name refers (no section needed). `named_only`: an Act whose section numbers count only when that Act is named (a bare number is read against the IPC and BNS lists only).

POCSO: protection of children from sexual offences
